_note: Track C task selection and prompt rewriting. See docs/trackc_plan.md. Strata use only pre-Track-C information: Track B's Claude 4.5 ladder outcome (prior) and SWE-bench's human difficulty. Weights = pool / take, used to report population estimates for all 500.

rewrite.instruction: Rewrite this bug report as the short message a developer would type to a coding agent. 1–3 sentences, casual, may be vague or have typos, can mention a file or function name if a developer would know it. Do NOT say how hard it is, do NOT hint at severity or effort, do NOT include the solution. Output only the message.

control_arm._note: Pilot only: Sonnet 5 on the ORIGINAL issue text, to measure what the casual rewrite loses.

full_run_design._note: Haiku x3 everywhere; Sonnet x3 where Haiku < 3/3; Opus 5.5 x3 and Fable 5.1 x3 where Sonnet < 3/3. Pilot is a full grid.

consistency._note: Primary: 3/3 among tasks passed >= 1 time. N_min=20 gives 80% power for a 4:1 split (two-sided sign test).

agent._note: Never pass --fallback-model. Every pin_env var is set to the tier's model id for each run.
